phases.title: Household logo preset: schema + profile plumbing
preconditions: DATABASE_URL must NOT point at the production database. Assert this before running db:migrate; if it is prod, abort and fail the phase — do not prompt, do not proceed.
testsFirst: features/household/__tests__/api/household-profile.test.ts: PUT { logoPreset: 'crescent' } persists and a subsequent GET returns logoPreset='crescent'
household-profile PUT rejects an unknown logoPreset key with HTTP 400
household-profile GET returns logoPreset undefined/null for a household that never set one
implementationSteps: Add nullable `logo_preset` text column to the households table in db/schema.ts (pure column add — no FK/UNIQUE, so the drizzle composite-FK ordering caveat does not apply)
npm run db:generate; inspect the generated SQL under db/migrations; after asserting DATABASE_URL is non-prod, npm run db:migrate
Add `logoPreset?: string` to HouseholdProfile in features/lib/types.ts; map it in profileFromRowAndSettings; whitelist-validate it in the PUT handler against the 5 known preset keys
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record the generated migration filename, the exact list of 5 allowed logo preset keys, and confirmation that logoPreset round-trips through GET/PUT and invalid keys are rejected.

phases.title: Attention Hub: alerts type + getAlerts() cross-feature emitters
testsFirst: getAlerts emits a gradebook alert (sourceFeature 'gradebook') for a learner with a needsAttention subject, and none when there are no flags
getAlerts emits a compliance alert (sourceFeature 'compliance') for a not-completed deadline whose dueDate is within the due-soon window, and none when the deadline is completed or far out
getAlerts emits a schedule-imbalance alert when a subject is scheduled >=2x on today for a learner, and none otherwise
existing alerts API test (features/alerts/__tests__/api/alerts.test.ts) still returns the aggregated array unchanged for planner + attendance
implementationSteps: Extend AlertSourceFeature in features/alerts/types.ts with 'gradebook' | 'compliance' (no change to the Alert shape)
In alerts/server/service.ts getAlerts(): read listGradebookSummaries(householdId) and emit one alert per needsAttention subject (severity medium, href /growth/gradebook?childId=)
Read getActiveSchoolYear(householdId) then listDeadlines(householdId, schoolYearId); emit a compliance alert for each not-completed deadline within the due-soon window (href /compliance)
Emit the salvaged 'schedule imbalance' rule from the lessons already fetched (a subject scheduled >=2x on today for one learner)
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record the due-soon window value used for compliance deadlines, the new sourceFeature values, and confirmation the existing planner/attendance alerts are unchanged.

phases.title: Gradebook overallMastery (composer-safe current grade)
testsFirst: listGradebookSummaries returns overallMastery = average of non-null subject masteryAverage values
overallMastery is null when a learner has no scored subjects
overallMastery ignores subjects whose masteryAverage is null
implementationSteps: Add `overallMastery: number | null` to GradebookSummary in features/gradebook/types.ts
Compute it in listGradebookSummaries (average of non-null subject masteryAverage; null when none) so the dashboard never averages
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record the rounding/precision used for overallMastery and confirm it is null (not 0) when a learner has no scores.

phases.title: Compliance status card (Zone C)
testsFirst: ComplianceStatusCard shows a spinner/skeleton while loading
shows an empty state ('Set up compliance') when there is no active school year
shows a retry affordance on fetch error
renders green/amber/red status, reasons, and the next deadline when populated
implementationSteps: Create a self-fetching ComplianceStatusCard (pattern: SchoolYearProgressCard): resolve active school-year id via getActiveSchoolYearId, then complianceApi.getStatus + getDeadlines
Render StatusEngineResult status color + reasons + next deadline; handle loading / empty / error states per ui-style-guide card pattern
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record the empty-state copy and how the next deadline is selected (earliest not-completed dueDate).

phases.title: Zone B per-learner command center
testsFirst: renders one row per active learner with attendance %, today's lessons X/Y, and a current grade value
a metric with no data renders '—' rather than crashing or showing a fake number
clicking a learner row calls setSelectedChildId and the dashboard scopes to that learner (assert context/URL)
renders loading, empty (no learners), and error states
reset sessionStorage between tests to avoid LearnerContext selectedChildId leakage
implementationSteps: Build LearnerCommandRow + LearnerCommandCenter container reading attendanceApi.getSummary (per child), plannerApi.getLessons (today), gradebookApi.getSummaries (overallMastery)
Row click sets the global learner filter via LearnerContext setSelectedChildId; no new page
No trend arrow, no per-learner compliance indicator (explicitly out)
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record how attendance % is derived from AttendanceSummary.byStatus and the N-per-child fetch count for reviewers.

phases.title: Household logo presets: UI (picker + render)
testsFirst: the picker cycles through the 5 preset marks and persists the selection (household PUT called with logoPreset)
HouseholdSwitcher renders the household's selected preset mark
a household with no chosen preset renders the default mark (no broken image, no crash)
implementationSteps: Create a logoPresets registry of 5 inline SVG marks keyed by the allowed preset keys from P1
Add a cycling HouseholdLogoPicker; wire it into HouseholdSetup and HouseholdSettings; persist via householdApi PUT logoPreset
Render the chosen preset (or default) in HouseholdSwitcher via useHousehold().householdProfile.logoPreset
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record the 5 preset keys/names and where the mark renders (switcher + any dashboard brand slot).

phases.title: Dashboard re-shell into three zones + cuts
testsFirst: the dashboard renders three labeled zones in order: Today, Per-learner, Proof & Progress
the Attention Hub renders aggregated alerts with a learner chip on every item (household-scoped reads 'Household')
the per-learner command center rows render in Zone B
PersonalAssistantPanel and RecordsProof no longer render on Home
the Personal To-dos list renders all items with no inner scroll container; the header date is plain text, not a button
Start learning time appears in the schedule panel footer and the standalone LearningTimeEntry card is gone
implementationSteps: Restructure Dashboard.tsx into Zone A/B/C; place the Attention Hub in Zone A; mount ComplianceStatusCard + LearnerCommandCenter
Merge Start learning time into the TodaySchedulePanel footer; remove the LearningTimeEntry card usage
Delete PersonalAssistantPanel + assistantRules usage; remove RecordsProof from Home (it stays on /records)
Slim Zone C (Compliance, School Year, Qur'an rings, Islamic, full non-scrolling To-dos); fix the compounding padding; render the header date as a plain label
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: List the components removed from Home, the final Zone C order, and any dashboard tests updated for the new structure.

phases.title: Learning-Time weekly chart card (optional)
testsFirst: the card buckets learningTimeApi.list({from,to}) sessions into weekday bars
the card renders an empty-week state when there are no sessions
implementationSteps: Build a weekly bar-chart card from learningTimeApi.list({from,to}) with client-side daily bucketing (precedent: QuranStreak.calcStreak / SchoolYearProgressCard.computeProgress)
If zero client aggregation is preferred, skip this phase and open a follow-up for a learning-time weekly-summary endpoint
doneWhen: npm run build passes with no type or lint errors
phases.writeBack: Record whether the chart was built or deferred, and the bucketing window used.
